⚡ Breaking: Customers are reporting difficulty accessing online accounts at some major banks. Bank of America, Chase, U.S. Bank, Wells Fargo and Truist were among those listed by the website downdetector.com as facing issues.

  • Chase Bank experienced a technical bug, not a cyber issue, and customers "have access to their accounts and funds," a spokesperson said. Get the latest.
 
 
1 big thing: '28 Dems face AI litmus test
 
Illustration: Sarah Grillo/Axios. Stock: Getty Images

Democrats in six early 2028 primary states expect their presidential nominee to prioritize AI regulations and reject industry money, Maria Curi reports from new polling data shared first with Axios.

🖼️ The big picture: The midterms showed how AI and data centers are top issues for voters, but politicians and their staff are still figuring out what a winning AI platform will look like in 2028.

In the Hart Research poll, which surveyed 3,011 likely 2028 Democratic primary voters in South Carolina, Nevada, New Hampshire, New Mexico, Michigan and Virginia from Oct. 26 to Nov. 3:

  • 83% of respondents said that it's important for their party's next presidential nominee to refuse campaign contributions from AI companies and executives.
  • 91% want the Democratic nominee to have an AI policy plan.
  • 88% want a commitment to pass comprehensive AI legislation in their first year in office.

🤖 Roughly half say that Democratic candidates aren't talking enough about AI.

  • 76% want states to retain the power to regulate AI alongside the federal government.

Key Democratic players received the data a few days after the midterms at a San Francisco event hosted by Who Decides, a group advocating for tighter AI regulation.

  • An adviser for Who Decides tells Axios that attendees "came into the room with post-midterm curiosity and left convinced that, yes, 2028 will be the AI election."

2. ⛽️ Sub-$6 diesel
 
Data: AAA; Chart: Ben Geman/Axios

Average U.S. diesel prices inched below $6 per gallon today for the first time since Sept. 10, Axios' Ben Geman writes, citing AAA data.

The big picture: Diesel has soared even more than gasoline during the Iran war, and those costs rippled throughout the economy.

🛢️ Yes, but: The global diesel supply crunch persists even as the broader oil market is starting to fitfully stabilize.

  • Ukrainian attacks on Russian refineries, damage to Middle Eastern production and shipments, throttled oil supplies, and expanded U.S. exports to meet overseas demand helped raise domestic costs.

How a family business uses Claude to stay true to its roots
 
 

Bama Sea Products started in 1977 with two shrimp boats. Today, the Florida-based company competes in a global market using custom tools the team built with Claude to uphold the quality and safety standards the business has always stood for.

3. ⚡️ Catch me up
 
Image: Amazon MGM Studios
  • 🎬 English actor Robert Pattinson will be the next James Bond, Amazon MGM announced today. He said in a statement: "James Bond is one of the most legendary characters in cinema, and to be entrusted with 007 is the honor of a lifetime." Denis Villeneuve is directing what will be the first Bond movie in the franchise's Amazon MGM era. More from Variety ... Read the announcement.
  • 🧑‍⚖️ Lindsay Clancy will face a second trial in March in the killings of her three young children. Her first trial ended in a mistrial after jurors couldn't reach a unanimous verdict on whether she was criminally responsible for their deaths. Get the latest.
  • 🇨🇳 The Trump administration released a new rule to close a loophole that allowed sensitive U.S. tech to reach China through data centers in Southeast Asia. Go deeper.
Composite photo: AP

P.S. Previous actors who've portrayed James Bond (from left): Sean Connery, David Niven, George Lazenby, Roger Moore, Timothy Dalton, Pierce Brosnan and Daniel Craig.

 
 
4. 🎸 1 for the road: Raye ties Bey
 
Raye performs in Dublin in March. Photo: Kieran Frost/Redferns

English singer-songwriter Raye leads the 2027 Grammy Award nominations, revealed today.

  • She's up for 11 awards at February's ceremony: record, song and album of the year — the first time she's been nominated in those categories — as well as songwriter of the year/non-classical, a variety of pop categories, and music video.

🐝 That's a tie with Beyoncé's record for the most nominations in a single year by a female artist, set last year.

How a small lab is giving more patients next-day answers
